mapper.sql: c.id AS comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.id ASC
SELECT FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
